description: Search GetLawED's library of official South African legal texts (Constitutional Court, SCA, High Court, Labour, Land, Tax and tribunal judgments; Acts; regulations, rules and codes issued under them; municipal by-laws and land use schemes; Bills; Government Gazettes). Returns matching documents with the best-matching section reference where the text is split into sections, a short passage and the official source link. Absence from the library does not mean an authority does not exist. South African law only unless country is given (e.g. "GB" for United Kingdom Acts).

country.description: Jurisdiction to search. Default "ZA" = South African law only. "GB" = United Kingdom Acts of Parliament (legislation.gov.uk, revised text; Open Government Licence v3.0 — show the attribution returned with each result). "US" = United States federal law (US Code, Constitution, federal regulations, Supreme Court opinions; public domain; no state law). "GE" = Georgia (laws as published by the Legislative Herald, Georgian + English; Constitutional and Supreme Court decisions, Georgian). "all" = every jurisdiction held. Each result carries its country and jurisdiction: only results with country "ZA" are South African law — never present a result from another country as South African law.

doc_type.description: Limit to one kind of document: regulation = regulations, rules and codes; bylaw = municipal by-laws and land use schemes (default: judgment, act and regulation)

query.description: What to look for, in plain language (e.g. "business rescue post-commencement tax debt")

name: legal_library_search
title: Search South African law
